title: Grading Summary
description: Cohort grading roll-up, written to grading/<assignment-id>/summary.json in the control repo. TWO surfaces write this file - `pxl-classroom grade` (local docker/host runners) and the Admin Panel's read of GitHub Actions check runs - and until this schema existed neither validated it. The Assignment detail view joins it onto reports/<assignment-id>.json by login to fill the Score and CI Status columns.

graded_by.description: GitHub login of the lecturer who ran it. Null when the session had no user on hand.

ci_status.description: The check run's conclusion (success | failure | cancelled | timed_out | …). Recorded because '0 out of 20' and 'the run never finished' are different facts, and the student table shows them differently.

ci_run_url.description: Link to the Actions run the score was read from. The per-test breakdown lives there and nowhere else - check-run annotations carry only the grand total.

score_source.description: Where the number came from. `conclusion` means no reporter annotation was found and the grade is all-or-nothing, which is not the same kind of fact as a parsed score.

hand_ins.description: The hand-in count under `submission_marker.max_hand_ins`, as lib/submission-marker.mjs `selectHandIn` decided it at `graded_at`. Absent when the assignment has no cap. On a failed row too: a student whose graded hand-in has no run still used 3 of 2.

used.description: Hand-ins on or before this student's deadline. May exceed `allowed` - that is the fact.

allowed.description: The assignment's cap plus this student's (or their team's most generous) allowance.

extra.description: How much of `allowed` is a per-student allowance.

pushed_at.description: When GitHub started the first run for it - server time.

on_branch.description: false: known only from the run history, because the branch was rewritten. Still counted.

number.description: Its position among the on-time hand-ins; null for a late one.
